author: Ogrey
body:
Hey guys! Today I present you all my new map I have named Sanatorium, and it's mostly... a mystery!
I cannot really tell much about it, but it's gonna be a big surprise :)

Map Name: Sanatorium
Map Creator: Evocal
Gamemode: ?
Basic Info:
- Blue (Blutarch) vs Red (Redmond)
- 20 vs 20
- You cannot build in this map, meaning it will be 100% PvP action.
- Everyone gets a speed boost.
- Iron Blocks are inside rooms (that's the only place where you'll be able to build).
